title: Online Safety: Scams, SPAM, Viruses and Clouds (Cyber Security Community Book 1)
description: Have you ever received a phone call informing you that you have a virus on your computer, or a slow Internet connection? Have you ever wondered why you get so much SPAM? Are you concerned your computer might end up with a virus and you'll lose all your files? Does anyone know what the Cloud actually is? This guide has been compiled by the local and online community in an attempt to answer some of these questions. Its audience is primarily those who are unfamiliar with computers and technology and are worried about the security of their computer or being the subject of a scam or fraud. However, even those familiar with computers may benefit from the collection of ideas and anecdotes. Online safety is as important as safety in your home, or on the street. Our lives are being forced online (whether we like it or not), yet not all of us are comfortable in venturing onto the Internet. What's more, scammers and criminals are taking advantage of those of us who are making these first tentative steps into the world of email, Internet banking and social media. This guide will be updated as new ideas are generated, or as feedback is provided. title: Teach Your Dragon Online Safety: A Story About Navigating the Internet Safely and Responsi
description: Teach Your Children Online Safety and Navigating the Internet Safely and Responsibly (My Dragon Books – Volume 66). Having a pet dragon like Diggory Doo is so much fun! You can teach him to sit, roll over, and play… You can teach him to make friends, control his anger, overcome his anxiety, show respect, and more… Diggory Doo is like any other kid who loves the digital world…From schoolwork to games, from videos to social media, the online world is his playground. But what if his online world is getting out of hand? What if your dragon soon discovers not all online adventures are fun and games? What if he stumbles upon distressing content from a video that is not supposed to be for kids? What if a stranger – a mysterious friend – in a game asks him to share personal details? What if all his in-app purchases are racking up? What if his social media behaviors are pushing friends away? And much more… What should you do? You teach him online safety! You show him the dos and don’ts of sharing personal information? You help him understand the lasting impact of a single post You teach him valuable lessons about navigating the online world responsibly. You show him the importance of setting boundaries, thinking before clicking, and help him learn the power of responsibility that comes with being an internet user. More importantly, you teach him how to balance the online and the real world, how to unplug from his devices, the importance of face-to-face interactions, and how to enjoy the real world around him… How do you do this? Get this book now and learn how! With its delightful illustrations, engaging storyline, and relatable characters, this book is an essential guide, lesson, and conversation starter for parents, teachers, counselors, and educators to teach online safety. title: THE INTERNET IS NOT YOUR FRIEND: Online Safety For Teens: Protection from Scams, Sextortio
cats: Teen & Young Adult Technology Nonfiction eBooks
description: You can't watch over your teen every time they go online. But you can teach them how to protect themselves when you're not there. As a parent of two teenagers, the online world worries me more than the real world sometimes. Not because the internet is “all bad,” but because it’s like letting your child go out at night in a busy area. Most people and places are fine. But some people are looking for easy targets, and some corners are simply not worth walking into. Some schools cover online safety, but not in enough detail. If children are spending hours online every day, shouldn’t they be taught how to handle it properly? This is the guide I wanted my own kids to have. In simple, clear language, it covers what to watch for, what to do first, and how to recover quickly: Privacy & Footprints : Locking down settings and understanding digital permanence. Manipulation : Spotting scams, fake jobs, and “urgent” messages designed to pressure. When It Gets Serious : Cyberbullying, grooming, sextortion, catfishing, and exactly what to do first. AI & Misinformation : Recognizing deepfakes, fake news, and using AI chatbots safely. Security : Passwords, preventing account takeovers, and what evidence to save. The Safety Plan : Where to get help, and a plan your child will actually use. The goal isn’t to scare anyone off the internet. title: Online Safety - The Secret Behind the Screen (The Safety Explorers Book 1)
description: The Secret Behind the Screen The Safety Explorers — Volume 1: An Online Safety Adventure By Sahani Ages 6–10 A mysterious message. A secret online club. A strange player hiding behind the screen. Can three young explorers solve the mystery? Meet Maya, Leo, Zara, and their adorable blue robot owl, Pip! These curious friends love playing games, building imaginary worlds, and solving puzzles. But one rainy afternoon, a mysterious message appears in their favorite online game, inviting them to join a secret club. Who sent the message? Why does the stranger want them to keep secrets? And what happens when someone online pretends to be a person they know? As the mystery grows, the friends discover that not everything on the internet is what it seems! Join The Safety Explorers on an exciting, fun-filled adventure that helps children understand how to enjoy the digital world while making safer choices. Through engaging storytelling and colorful illustrations, children will discover: Why personal information, passwords, and private details should be protected. How online strangers may pretend to be friends or familiar people. Why suspicious messages, secret invitations, and exciting prizes deserve a closer look. How photos, videos, and games can accidentally reveal personal information. When to stop, think, and ask a trusted adult for help. Why making a mistake online is never a reason to stay silent. More than just a safety book — it's an adventure that builds curiosity, confidence, and smart thinking! Written in simple, easy-to-understand English for children ages 6–10 , this illustrated chapter book combines mystery, friendship, humor, and important life lessons without making learning feel like a lecture. title: A Parent's Guide to Online Safety: Simple Steps to Protect Your Kids From Online Predators
description: You don’t need to be a tech expert to protect your kids online—just a proactive, informed parent. The digital world offers incredible opportunities for kids to learn, connect, and grow—but it also exposes them to real dangers. From online predators and cyberbullies to gaming scams, deepfakes, and risky social media trends, today’s children are navigating threats that many parents never experienced growing up. That’s where this book comes in. In A Parent’s Guide to Online Safety , cybersecurity expert Alex East breaks down the complex, ever-changing landscape of online risks into clear, manageable steps any parent can take—no jargon, no fear tactics, just real-world advice that works. With over two decades of experience in cybersecurity and a passion for protecting families, Alex empowers parents with the knowledge and tools they need to raise safe, smart digital citizens. Whether your child is just getting their first device or already deep into social media, messaging apps, or online gaming, this book meets you where you are.
